title: Extract the duplicated drift .sqlite-suffix delete helper out of AccountLifecycleService and PendingLocalSignupStore
why: Both private _deleteDbFile methods encode the identical drift_flutter '.sqlite'-suffix-with-bare-name-fallback workaround, each discovered and fixed as a separate bug (each carries its own header comment and its own dedicated regression test in this batch: account_lifecycle_db_delete_test.dart and pending_local_signup_file_cleanup_test.dart). Any future drift_flutter version change to the on-disk filename scheme means this exact fix has to be found and reapplied in two places; missing one leaves orphaned .sqlite files on disk or a delete that silently no-ops.
recommendation: Extract one shared deleteDriftDbFile(databasesPath, dbFileName) utility (e.g. under core/database/ or core/utils/) that both services call; keep both existing regression tests but retarget them at the shared utility.
acceptance_criteria: one shared function implements the .sqlite-suffix delete-with-fallback logic
AccountLifecycleService and PendingLocalSignupStore both delegate to it instead of each defining their own copy
both existing regression tests still pass
